description.value: Altitudes Bistro sits at the summit of Grouse Mountain, roughly 3,700 feet above the Lower Mainland, serving distinctly British Columbian cuisine with sweeping views. It is one of several dining options at the Grouse Mountain resort, which also hosts a lift-accessed mountain bike park with rentals and guided camps. The restaurant is reachable only by gondola (Skyride) or by hiking the Grouse Grind trail — not by bicycle from the base.
